passages.text: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
passages.sermon: Praise the LORD.\r\nA man who fears the LORD is blessed.\r\nHe loves God's commandments very much.
passages.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ אַשְׁרֵי־ אִ֭ישׁ יָרֵ֣א אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝מִצְוֺתָ֗יו חָפֵ֥ץ מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
passages.sermon:
A man fears the LORD.
He delights greatly in God's commandments.
His children will be mighty in the land.
God will bless the generation of upright people.
passages.original: גִּבּ֣וֹר בָּ֭אָרֶץ יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְע֑וֹ דּ֭וֹר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יְבֹרָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
passages.sermon:
The man fears the LORD.
He delights greatly in God's commandments.
Wealth is in his house.
Riches are in his house.
His righteousness endures forever.
passages.original: הוֹן־ וָעֹ֥שֶׁר בְּבֵית֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃

passages.text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
passages.sermon:
The upright person lives with grace, compassion, and righteousness.
Light shines for this person.
This light appears even in darkness.
passages.original: זָ֘רַ֤ח בַּחֹ֣שֶׁךְ א֭וֹר לַיְשָׁרִ֑ים חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם וְצַדִּֽיק׃

passages.text: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.
passages.sermon:
A good man acts with generosity.
He gives freely to others.
He lends to those in need.
He manages his affairs with justice.
He makes fair decisions in all he does.
passages.original: טֽוֹב־ אִ֭ישׁ חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה יְכַלְכֵּ֖ל דְּבָרָ֣יו בְּמִשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
passages.sermon: The righteous man stands firm forever.\r\nHe will never be shaken.\r\nPeople will always remember the righteous man.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ לְעוֹלָ֥ם לֹא־ יִמּ֑וֹט לְזֵ֥כֶר ע֝וֹלָ֗ם יִהְיֶ֥ה צַדִּֽיק׃

passages.text: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The righteous man does not fear bad news.
His heart stays firm.
He trusts in the LORD.
passages.original: מִשְּׁמוּעָ֣ה רָ֭עָה לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א נָכ֥וֹן לִ֝בּ֗וֹ בָּטֻ֥חַ בַּיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
passages.sermon:
The righteous man has a strong and steady heart.
He does not feel fear.
He remains unafraid.
He stays this way until he sees victory over his enemies.
passages.original: סָמ֣וּךְ לִ֭בּוֹ לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־ יִרְאֶ֣ה בְצָרָֽיו׃

passages.text: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.
passages.sermon:
This man gives freely to the poor.
He shares his gifts with those in need.
His righteousness lasts forever.
God will lift him up in honor.
People will respect him.
passages.original: פִּזַּ֤ר׀ נָ֘תַ֤ן לָאֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים צִ֭דְקָתוֹ עֹמֶ֣דֶת לָעַ֑ד קַ֝רְנ֗וֹ תָּר֥וּם בְּכָבֽוֹד׃

passages.text: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man sees.
He feels anger.
He grinds his teeth.
He wastes away.
The desires of wicked people perish.
passages.original: רָ֘שָׁ֤ע יִרְאֶ֨ה׀ וְכָעָ֗ס שִׁנָּ֣יו יַחֲרֹ֣ק וְנָמָ֑ס תַּאֲוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
